Bad bad game! Im glad as my backlog is big and my life is short!

Basically Zcrew is super shonky, everything feels like "good idea but poor execution" and I had been playing it because I should like it a lot (I love top down shooters with wsad+mouse), but it hadnt been feeling good, it had been feeling a very amateurishly put together (to be fair, making games is hard, so credit to the devs for getitng this far). 

And then wsad stopped working. 

So obviously I would get swarmed by zombies and die, respawned a couple of times, killing all the zombies until they were all gone, and there I was standing without being able to move. 

Good, this is conclusive proof this game is made quite poorly and I shouldnt be spending my time on it. I try to quit. It doesnt quit. Task manager says its not responding, so I kill it and get to write this review.

Nice idea, terrible execution, no need to play this one! Next! 

:)

First mission, kill 10 zombies....stuck at 8/10, had to restart game. 
Just no....nope....not even at $4.96. Very disappointing.
